about: Surge Digital Inc. owns, operates, and invests in businesses in the digital assets space industry in Canada, the United States of America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Netcoins, Blockchain Intelligence Group, and TerraZero. The Netcoins segment offers a regulated Canadian cryptocurrency trading platform that provides retail and institutional clients with digital asset transaction services, staking, and custody-related products. The Blockchain Intelligence Group segment provides QLUE, BitRank, Address Watch, and Entity Explorer tools for blockchain forensics, compliance technology, antimoney laundering detection tools, investigative software, and training programs, which serves law enforcement, financial institutions, virtual asset service providers, law firms and private crypto investigators, government and public sector, and other regulated entities. The TerraZero segment offers a metaverse and reality platform developer focusing on digital interaction, engagement experiences, and blockchain-integrated virtual environments. The company was formerly known as BIGG Digital Assets Inc. and changed its name to Surge Digital Inc. in August 2026. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
